messages:
maria.finance: Heads-up — flagged an invoice where AMP credits were applied mid-month and customer asked for a reversal/rebill. Need guidance for April close on how to treat the credit (deferral vs immediate reduction). @sam.revrec @alex.billing

sam.revrec: Can you paste the invoice lines or screenshot? need amounts and invoice date.

alex.billing: Pulling now. Looks like invoice 2024-04128: usage charges $12,000; promo/AMP credit -$8,000; net due $4,000. Invoice date 2024-04-28. Customer requested reversal on 2024-04-30 and wants re-bill in May.

maria.finance: Exactly. Customer argument: system applied promo incorrectly for partial month and they want us to reverse and reissue. What's RevRec guidance for month-end entries?

joe.salesops: FWIW the contract addendum treats AMP credits as promotional discounts applied to usage, not an up-front prepaid. Customer is on a monthly consumption plan + trial credits. They asked for reversal because it affected their internal reporting.

sam.revrec: If credits are contra-revenue (per contract), treat them as reduction of gross usage revenue. For April close: because the invoice was issued and then reversed within period, we should 1) reverse recognized revenue for the credit amount, or 2) if we can't physically reverse by GAAP close timing, book an accrual/adjusting JE to reflect the expected reversal.

alex.billing: Proposed operational flow: a) create reversing invoice in AR to offset $8k, b) post adjusting journal to true-up P&L for April, c) create deferral schedule if credit will be spread. But since customer wants a one-time rebill in May, we should treat it as a short-term liability (deferred credit) until reissue.

sam.revrec: Concrete JE suggestion for April close: \n- Debit Revenue $8,000\n- Credit Accrued Liabilities / Deferred Credits $8,000
This leaves gross usage revenue recorded but moves the credit into a liability pending re-bill. When we reissue (May), debit Deferred Credits, credit Revenue (or AR adjustments) appropriately.

alex.billing: That matches what I was thinking. Need GL accounts: Rev account 4001 (Usage Rev), Deferred Credits 2305. Also need approval for JE > $5k.

liz.finance_lead: Approved for JE posting. Please include a clear memo: "AMP credit reversal per cust request INC-4589; contract clause 3.2 applied; reversing entry for 2024-04 close."

maria.finance: Thanks. Billing: please include the customer ticket number on the JE and in the close package. We'll include the $8k accrual on the April close checklists so controllers see it.

billing-bot: /create-ticket INC-4591 JE draft created by alex.billing (links: https://ops.internal/inc/4591)

alex.billing: I'll draft the JE and attach invoice screenshots + contract clause text. Posting planned in tomorrow's cut (before final close). Will ping when posted.

maria.finance: Great. Also note: flag this customer for revenue QA — if we have multiple mid-month promos we may need a policy change (treatment consistent: contra-rev vs marketing expense). Adding a follow-up item to May agenda.

sam.revrec: Agree — add to RevRec policy review. For now, proceed with approved JE and deferral schedule.

maria.finance: Closing loop: JE approved, ticket created, billing to post JE and reissue invoice in May. I'll mark this in the close tracker and include on finance lead sign-off.
notes: Included contract reference and ticket IDs; short, choppy Slack style.
